name: web-mock-skill
description: Turn a prospect website, screenshots and page source into an assessment, branded HTML proposal and outreach email.

interface.shortDescription: Assess a website, build a mockup, draft outreach
interface.longDescription: Review a supplied website and brand references, then create an evidence-based assessment, responsive HTML redesign concept, SEO and AI-search opportunities, and an email the user can send.
defaultPrompt: Create a website assessment, branded HTML mockup and outreach email from this URL, screenshots and page source.
